title: Harborline Cloud 8 Upgrades: Billed Share by Term Length
content:
## Billed share of a Harborline Cloud 8 upgrade (Web Hosting Plans)

**Rule.** The share of the Cloud 8 upgrade charge that is billed depends on the plan's current term length:

- on a 24 or 36-month term with at least one whole calendar month remaining, it is the whole calendar months remaining from today to the term end date (a month counts only once its day of the month is reached) divided by the months of the term;
- on a 1-month term it is the whole price difference, with no proration;
- on every other term, including a 24 or 36-month term in its last month, it is the remaining days divided by the term days.

The price difference is the Cloud 8 term price minus the amount paid for the current term, and the billed share is applied to it.

| Current term | Whole calendar months remaining | Share billed |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or 36 months | 1 or more | whole months remaining divided by 24 or 36 |
| 24 or 36 months | 0 (last month) | remaining days divided by term days |
| 12 months | any | remaining days divided by term days |
| 1 month | any | the whole price difference |

**Counting whole months (hypothetical dates).** Today 22 November 2030 and a term end date of 10 March 2032: a month is counted on each 22nd reached up to 22 February 2032, giving 15 whole months; 22 March 2032 falls after the term end date and is not counted.

**Worked cases (hypothetical price difference of USD 300.00).**

1. 36-month term from 10 March 2029 to 10 March 2032, today 22 November 2030: 15 divided by 36 of USD 300.00 is USD 125.00.
2. 24-month term from 10 March 2029 to 10 March 2031, today 15 February 2031: no whole month remains, so the share is 23 remaining days divided by 730 term days, and USD 300.00 times that share is 9.4521, rounded to USD 9.45.
3. 1-month term: the whole USD 300.00 is billed.
